crime_highlights: It is very likely both men could have stated who it was that fired that shot.
Both men were polite and respectful to the Court, but refused to testify, even after receiving legal advice
rationale_highlights: The Gladue report prepared for the underlying offence describes his mother's family history.
when I take the Gladue factors into account, I conclude that he should receive the same sentence as Mr. Lyde
note: Contempt for refusing to testify; Gladue applies to Martinez, not Bidesi.

crime_highlights: Mr. Forrest was the one who inflicted those blows
Mr. Regehr fell to the floor and banged his head
bound him to a tree around his neck and wrists
He had bled quite significantly, had hypothermia and appeared to be in shock
this would have been quite a horrifying experience
rationale_highlights: paints an appalling and nevertheless, unfortunately, quite common portrait of Mr. Forrest's family background
I will take into account his aboriginal background as an aspect of his moral blameworthiness in this case
will reflect that when I am considering the fitness of the joint submission
note: Gladue applies to co-offender Forrest; joint submission.

crime_highlights: Mr. Smith was selling drugs in front of the Carnegie Centre
made the mistake of offering them for sale to a plain-clothes constable of the Vancouver Police Department
13 flaps of fentanyl (approximately 2.6 grams in total)
rationale_highlights: I must consider the unique systemic and background factors which may have played a part in bringing Mr. Smith before the court
there is little evidence that any unique circumstances in Mr. Smith's Aboriginal background might lessen his culpability for the present offence
All of these factors, as well as his Aboriginal background and other personal circumstances warrant a sentence at the low end of the range referred to above
note: Court finds little Gladue evidence but cites background in choosing low end.
